description: Post-review case-name and source-count fixes; final single source-covering recency index, not a release or provider acceptance claim.

sampling.cold: fresh writable connection, warm OS cache
sampling.paired_source: read-only connections after one writable upgrade

methodology.indexless_write_control: Legacy core with only the ensurePerformanceIndex(db) call removed; no other behavior changed.
methodology.source_probe: Seed legacy core with 100000 deterministic records, clone the closed store, upgrade the clone with current core, compare exports/results, alternate measurement order across three pairs.
methodology.visibility_probe: For each 100000-record fixture, all indices not divisible by 101 are either soft-removed or expired; compare legacy and upgraded stores in active, expired, any and FTS source modes.
methodology.write_probe: Three alternating pairs, reused/cold connections, 100 measured create/content patches per side against identical populated indexless versus upgraded stores; setup outside timings.
methodology.tail_probe: Fresh incrementally indexed legacy/current seeds at affected sizes, three alternating pairs of 100 samples for each single-run regression candidate.
methodology.upgrade_probe: Six warm-cache indexless-to-current writable opens and one legacy-index replacement; excludes real competing-writer contention and cold disk.
methodology.budgets: 25% database size; 20% median create/content overhead across paired ratios; reject unaffected regressions exceeding both 20% and 0.2ms when reproduced in all three pairs.
methodology.caveats: One cold-create pair exceeded 20%; the other two and the three-pair median did not. Initial tail candidates did not persist across three pairs. No automatic ANALYZE or persistent-statistics maintenance was introduced.

verification.codex_preparation: passed separately after frozen install and validation; no native registration
verification.limitations: No live-provider, native Codex registration, desktop/IDE or accessibility certification.

functional_parity.verification_caveat: Legacy-writer verification follows a refreshed MATCH query. A separately reproduced, pre-existing SQLite cached-FTS integrity false alarm occurs before that refresh; a fresh connection also verifies cleanly.
